# Weather & Discomfort Index Report

> Real-time environmental and discomfort index reporting, comparing Japanese regional cities, famous hot spring (onsen) destinations, and major/extreme international locations.

## Overview
This application provides live weather updates including temperature, humidity, clear-text weather condition descriptions, and computed **Discomfort Index (DI)** values. It categorizes locations into comfort evaluations ranging from "Extremely Cold" to "Everyone Feels Uncomfortable".

- **Primary URL (English):** https://yahikoyama.github.io/weather2/weather_report_now_en.html
- **Secondary URL (Japanese):** https://yahikoyama.github.io/weather2/weather_report_now_ja.html
- **Data Update Frequency:** Hourly / Real-time updates

## Featured Location Categories

### 1. Domestic (Japan)
Coverage includes major Japanese metropolitan areas as well as renowned mountain and hot spring (onsen) resorts:
- **Resorts & Onsen:** Kusatsu Onsen, Ikaho Onsen, Minakami Onsen, Karuizawa, Nasu Highlands, Sugadaira
- **Regional Cities:** Sapporo, Asahikawa, Morioka, Niigata, Tokyo, Kyoto, Kitaibaraki, Katsuura, Wakkanai, Nemuro, Kushiro, Abashiri, Obihiro, Takayama, Aomori, Akita

### 2. Overseas (Global & Extreme Climates)
Coverage includes major international hubs along with iconic extreme/polar climate locations:
- **Extreme / Polar Climates:** Utqiaġvik (US), Longyearbyen (SJ), Nuuk (GL), Oymyakon (RU), Verkhoyansk (RU), Norilsk (RU), Tromsø (NO), Yellowknife (CA)
- **Global Cities:** Sydney (AU), Vancouver (CA), Cairns (AU), Lima (PE), Rio de Janeiro (BR), Harbin (CN), Honolulu (US), Ulaanbaatar (MN), Seoul (KR), Kuala Lumpur (MY)

## Key Metrics & Evaluation Criteria

### Discomfort Index (DI) Calculation
Calculated using temperature (T in °C) and relative humidity (RH in %):
DI = 0.81 * T + 0.01 * RH * (0.99 * T - 14.3) + 46.3

### Evaluation Thresholds
- **< 55:** Cold / Extremely Cold
- **55 – 60:** Chilly
- **60 – 65:** Neutral
- **65 – 70:** Comfortable
- **70 – 75:** Slightly Uncomfortable
- **75 – 80:** Half Feel Uncomfortable
- **> 80:** Everyone Feels Uncomfortable
